title: Brushed Bronze Towel Ring, 6-Inch Diameter, Wall Mount Solid Brass Bath Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Towel ring, 6-inch diameter, solid brass, wall mount bathroom towel holder for hand towels and decorative towels in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. Round ring design with 2-inch projection and concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look. Includes towel ring and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Rated 10 lb weight capacity for daily bathroom use. Contemporary style from the Foxtrot collection, ideal for matching Foxtrot and coordinating with textured bathroom hardware, designer bath accessories, designer bathroom hardware, and statement bath accessories. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Foxtrot collection.
